newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian coffee exports to total 10.6 mln bags.
newsitem.headline: Colombian coffee exports to total 10.6 mln bags.

text.p: Colombia will export a total of 10.6 million 60-kilo bags of coffee this year, including 5.15 million bags between July and December, Foreign Trade Minister Morris Harf said.

He provided the figures in a letter to Reuters clarifying his remarks earlier Thursday in an interview with the Caracol radio station in which he mistakenly referred to an "export target" of 12 million 60-kilo bags.

"With respect to Colombia's exports in 1996 it should be noted that the country, in keeping with its commitments with the Association of Coffee Producing Countries, will export 5.15 million bags of green coffee in the period between July and December of this year," the letter said.

"Total coffee exports in 1996 will therefore be 10.6 million bags," it added. It did not elaborate, but Harf said in his interview with Caracol that Colombia would be forced to draw on internal coffee stocks to meet its export commitments because of an expected 11.7 percent drop in parchment coffee production this year. -- Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944
